sections.A: Tennis elbow kohni ke bahar tendon ka load se juda masla hai, jahan kalai aur ungliyon ko seedha karne wali muscles judti hain.
sections.B: Kohni ke bahar dard jo forearm tak ja sakta hai, pakarne, uthane, haath milane aur screwdriver ghumane se barhta hai.
sections.C: Dard kahan hai, kaun se kaam barhate hain, aur kya gardan ya nerve ki wajah ho sakti hai.
sections.D: Sujan aur sukhna dekhein, lateral epicondyle aur tendon ko dabayein, aur gardan aur nerves screen karein.
sections.E: Tennis elbow clinical diagnosis hai. Cozen, Mill aur Maudsley tests wahi dard laate hain, lekin tear sabit nahi karte.
sections.F: Radial tunnel syndrome, gardan ka dard aur joint ke masle isi jaise lag sakte hain.
sections.G: Chot ke baad sujan aur baazu seedha na hona, ya garam laal sooji kohni aur bukhar: foran refer.
sections.H: Red flags, phir gardan ya nerve ki wajah. Kuch na ho aur bahar dard, dabane aur resisted test par dard ho to tennis elbow.
sections.I: Mulligan lateral glide (mobilisation with movement) se thori der ka aaraam aur behtar pakar.
sections.J: Asal ilaaj tendon load hai: pehle isometric holds se dard shant, phir dheere dheere bhaari load.
sections.K: Barf, garmi aur TENS optional. Lambe dard mein shockwave ek option.
sections.L: Gardan aur nerve screen karein, samjhayein ke yeh hafton-mahinon mein behtar hota hai, dard wala grip kam karein, phir load barhayein.
sections.M: Dard ke baghair grip ki taaqat, kaam mein dard aur PRTEE dobara napein.
sections.N: 46 saal ke mechanic ko auzaar pakarte waqt kohni ke bahar dard hai. Khud socho, phir jawab dekho.
sections.chapter-summary-treatment-decision: Mukhtasar: education, load control aur dheere dheere barhta load.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
